description: Return ALL events (server + browser) within +/- windowMs of a timestamp, time-ordered — the correlation tool. E.g. the browser console error and the backend stack trace from the same moment. Includes every network request in the window — successful ones too, not just failures — so a 200 that returned bad data is visible here. Timestamps come from the `ts` field on any event.

app.description: Optional: scope to one app/project (pane label or id; see pane_list).

name: get_logs_around
